title: HackerEarth: Monk being Monitor
description: Monk wants to find two distinct student heights `h1` and `h2` such that `h1 > h2` and the frequency of `h1` minus the frequency of `h2` is maximized. If no positive difference exists, return -1.
constraints:
1 <= len(heights) <= 10^5
• Time: O(N log N) | Space: O(N)
solution:
def max_frequency_diff(heights: list[int]) -> int:
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(heights)
    sorted_heights = sorted(counts.keys())
    if len(sorted_heights) < 2:
        return -1
    max_diff = -1
    min_freq = counts[sorted_heights[0]]
    for h in sorted_heights[1:]:
        freq = counts[h]
        if freq - min_freq > max_diff:
            max_diff = freq - min_freq
        min_freq = min(min_freq, freq)
    return max_diff if max_diff > 0 else -1
explanation: Sorting distinct heights ascending and tracking min frequency so far allows finding max frequency advantage in O(N log N) time.
